This cephalopod inspired robot is a ghoulish spektor that haunts archeotech ruins.

It is a remix of Akewea's Sci-Fi Sphere Drone (https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:5266420) and Franklima260's Mini Servo Arm (https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/sci-fi-sphere-drone)

The arms are fully posable with ball & socket joints at the shoulder, elbow, and wrist.

Since the attachment point to the base is pretty small, I've included 4 additional versions of the tentacles with a rod cutout for pinning of the following sizes
- 1mm brass rod (1.1mm hole)
- 1.5mm brass rod (1.6mm hole)
- 0.8mm thin paperclip (0.9mm hole)
- 1.15mm thick paperclip (1.25mm hole)

item.description:

Id objet : updated-repair-arm

Prix : 0 euros

Collections :

  • 28mm IMP Bits

Collections pour tags :

  • 28mm IMP Bits NONDL NONSUP

Description :

1
2
3

An updated version of my previous (now deactivated) file pack for a robotic arm which I made months back. Besides fixing some geometry and STL file issues which were present in the first pack, I also decided to add some additional details to it. The components of the arms are left separate to hopefully avoid non manifold geometry issues as well as allowing anyone to separate the arms for reposing. The claw is also separate from the arm now, allowing some extra freedom in posing. The base and arm also have a slot for a 6mmx3mm circular magnet to keep the two parts together without needing to permanently attach them.

Hope you all enjoy this one and feel free to reach out to me if you encounter any issues with the models. Enjoy

"Every battlefield the Hostile Environment Troops find themselves on, is a hostile, bombarded and chemically saturated one. Taking trenches, cities and sectors require troops in the thousands, and waiting for weeks or months on end for the right moment to strike. To that end, Command uses Shock Assault Troops, Specialists in lightning warfare.

Other armies decorate these soldiers in honors, having them as elite regiments on their planets. The best of the best.
Not so for the Hostile Environment Troops, for in the hellish condition they find themselves in, a simple hole in their suits means they are living on borrowed time.
Most, but not all, Shock Assault are penal legionaires, promised freedom if they survive a single attack on an enemy position. Very few survive to see reinforcements, fewer still survive long enough for a commissar to excuse them of their sins and turn them free men and women.

The life of a Shock Assault Trooper is a short and deadly life, but their sacrifices turn the tide of battle, saving thousands.

Enlist Today!"

This kit is a conversion kit for the newest plastic cadians. The torsos fit the equivelant piece in the assembling book in the plastic box.

there are
7 different heads
11 different torsos

All heads can be given female proportions by decreasing their width by roughly 8%

Note: Some cutting of the plastic legs are required

Here are twelve, perhaps crude, though definitely brutal close combat hand-to-hand melee assault weapons. They are intended to allow give you some extra options and conversion bits for your Chaos Cultists. You do love Chaos Cultists don't you?? Though I think they are generic enough to work for most human sized miniatures in any grim and dark dystopian future setting from undercity gangs, to wasteland scavengers, rebels, organized criminal thugs, and pretty much any kind of poorly equipped ne'er-do-wells up to no good.

Here are the 12 unique weapons:

-- Axe
-- Club
-- Hammer1
-- Hammer2
-- Knife1
-- Knife2
-- Mace
-- Pick
-- Pipe
-- Scimitar
-- Sword1
-- Sword2

Each weapon comes in three STL variants:
1) weapon by itself
2) weapon held in a right hand
3) weapon held in a right hand (hand has a nub to socket into wrists)

Knife1 and Knife2 have four variants each, two with the blade held normally and two with the blade held ready to stab. You can mirror the weapons with hands on them to create left-handed versions. All total that comes to 68 different options. You can use these files for physical or digital conversions as you see fit. They are also Creative Common Licensed so that you can modify them as you please and then share your own innovations.

Enjoy, and may the Dark Gods favor you.

This revised version of my old Autopistol STL has some subtle changes that I like. I also added a few variants with different hands attached for easy conversions. In a grimdark science fantasy universe such a weapon as this might be found in the hands of chaotic cultists, undercity gang members, Imperial officials, militia troopers, organized criminals, xeno cultists, merchants and their guards, household troops, and many more. For physically converting or digitally remixing miniatures this one pistol has many potential uses.

I made some changes to my existing Autopistol Model 302 STL. I took most of my inspiration for the original design from a couple images I found online. I liked the look overall, though I felt like the end of the barrel was maybe inclined to break off if dropped. So for this version I changed the proportions so that the muzzle break in front of the weapon connected very slightly to the angled front of the forward handgrip on the pistol. Looking at other images online, I also decided to shorten the pistol's ammo magazine. Previously the magazine extended below the pistol grip, but now it stops just short of being equal in length to the pistol grip. The width and height of the pistol remain the same, but I shortened the overall length from 12mm to 11.5mm which I think makes it scaled a bit better for most plastic, resin, and STL miniatures out there.

Here's a link to the original version.

Autopistol - Model 302 -by- Scavvon
https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/autopistol-model-302

---------------

When servants of the Inquistion must hunt heretics in the dangerous depths of the undercity it never hurts to have some extra firepower. That's were the Servile Cyborg with Sizable Gun comes in. This single-minded automaton can pack as much firepower as a crew served heavy weapon team. He never complains, but he rarely takes any initiative either. In fact, he performs best with a bit of guidance from his friends. He can be equipped with a selection of three devastating heavy weapons depending on your needs. The ODV Heavy Blaster launches bursts of high caliber dual-mode projectiles that are equally effective against armored or unarmored targets. One shot from this weapon is more than enough to deal with a measely chaotic cultist. The opposite end of the spectrum is the mighty Multi-Mazer Melta-Beamer. This weapon hits just one target, but it hits extremely hard! Definitely a waste when targeting a wimpy chaotic cultist, but hulking mutant abominations or vile places of worship for the followers are the Dark Gods are ideal targets. The final weapon option is the Phased Plasma Projector, this weapon is the happy medium of overkill. It hits like a cargo-8 and covers an area wide enough to catch multiple targets. As an additional benefit this particular Servile Cyborg's Sizable Guns each have unique enhancements to improve their reliability. Because let's face it, there is never a techno-guru around when you need one, let alone when you are in the heart of darkness battling heretics.

--------------------------------

ATTN: Square/Sony this is freely available fan art. If there's a problem, please just tell me to take it down. These have not been nor will they ever be made available for sale.

Some of you know I did Jenova a while back. Well I wanted the whole crew but the only one I found was low poly, or the collection listed below which is nice but I wanted a bit more detail. About half of this project is a remix, I did check and am allowed to remix the parts I did use. Huge shoutout to the original sculptors.


For those wanting these but don't have a 3d printer, you can use a print service.


Here are the parts I used in the remix because I don't trust thingi to actually list them on the side:

Vincents gun

Tifa

What was done with each model:

Tifa: Tifa was basically untouched as the original is amazing and stood in for a quality control standard

Chocobo: I thickend the feathers a bit so they print easier

Cait Sith: I cleaned up the stuffed animal part a little and made new wings for it.

Red XII: Cleaned up and leveled out a bit

The others were pretty much only used as an example for the pose.

The sculpting on:

Commentary :

All of the design backgrounds were based on the Roguetrader (1st Edition) and the 2nd and 3rd Edition designs.

As always, based on the design of the time, I mixed the design sensibilities of the present era.

Personally, I recommend that the size of the shoulder pad is 105-108%, and the size of the head is 95%. (That looks good.)

I got a lot of help from my colleague, LegioXIVguy, in determining the ratio and size. So the overall size is about between New edition Chaos space marines and Primaris marines.

Have you ever looked at the beloved Angry Spaceguard sets created by Ziocru, LoggyK, and others, and thought to yourself "Well, yes, these guys are ANGRY, but surely they could be equally angry and ALSO fancy?"

Well worry no more! Now, thanks to myself, the aforementioned creators, and a borrowed horse from Andy Woodhead over on Sketchfab, your angry boys can be the fanciest (yet still angry) men in all of space!

Or, well, EVENTUALLY they will be. Right now, I'm mostly uploading these because I have to put some files SOMEWHERE as backup while I try to get my computer fixed, so here's as good a spot as any. Just, you know, Caveat Emptor because this is still very much a Work-In-Progress set.


----

V 0.2 update: Added new lower bodies, adjusted torsos, put Aquilas on hats and buttons. Replaced the Andy Woodhead horse with one of the 28mm Horses At Ease by BREXIT.

And many thanks to Ben Antilles for reminding me that I needed to take a second look at those legs.

Note that the heads may be a bit too big right now, if they are, set them to size 0.75.

There is something about cultists of all kinds, they just love their slug throwing stubbers, especially the Big Stubber. What can you say, it's just iconic? Would any of them really be worth calling cultists if they didn't have their Big Stubbers? I've decided to build an army of Frateris Militia led by an Apostate Cardinal. Let's be honest, Frateris Militia are basically imperial cultists. And as such, they will need their own Big Stubbers, lots of Big Stubbers.

I started with LoggyK's excellent Heavy Gun for this design and I just kept adding details until I had the look of a xeno-cultist Big Stubber. The final model is sort of a mix of old and new. The scale should be 1-1.

This model wouldn't have been possible without the talent and generosity of LoggyK.

Hey friend, I would appreciate a lot if you'll check my Boosty first, it's like Patreon, but local. There are some... issues with Cults.
https://boosty.to/easyv

In the vast world of 40k exist a myriad of various marks, patterns and types of humble lasgun, and, as usual, GW had forgot about most of them. Fine, I'll do it myself. This compendium is mine attempt to render at least some of the canon models and some inspired by real life and media. But not only that - aside from prebuilt models every gun is separated to its base components - central part, barrel, grip, stock, sight and attachment. Because half of the fun comes from fine tuning the шмаляло for your needs.

Codex patterns: Kantrael, Kantrael Short, Mk4, Voss, Mars, Galaxy, Ryza, Triplex, Lucius - both FW and GW, Accatran, Vostroyan and some unnamed;
Non-codex models: WolfTNO Sturmgewehr 46 and 60, G36, M16, Colt Commando, HK53 both with or without M203 (or you can call it MP5, difference in this scale is not that big), Japenese Type 11 LMG and Type 97 AT rifle (that's some big longlas), AK-74, both regular and short, uuuh, ОЦ-14 (that not transliterates good) (k fine OTs-14).

Pick your poison - https://linktr.ee/easyv

Plasma weapons are extremely effective at close to medium range. Together with kinetic damage, it transfers significant thermal damage to the target. At close range, this weapon has a chance to damage even heavy armored vehicles. During the Last War, plasma weapons were widespread among the Shapers.

Despite its high efficiency, this weapon has its drawbacks. The lethality of the weapon decreases significantly with distance. The design of this weapon is quite complex, which requires a high production culture and careful maintenance. And in case of malfunctions, self-detonation of the weapon is quite possible.

Jet weapons became widespread during the Last War. The ammunition of this weapon is accelerated by a jet stream. It has practically no recoil, and ammunition can hit a wide variety of targets. Cumulative and armor-piercing ammunition can easily cope with light enemy vehicles. Ammunition with programmable detonation will not leave any chance for the infantry, even in cover.

However, this weapon also has a number of disadvantages. It is quite heavy and for long-term use it is necessary to have exo-armor or genetic modifications. It is also extremely ineffective at close ranges, since the ammunition does not have time to pick up the required speed.

The weapon can be equipped with various magazines. To improve the accuracy of fire, it is possible to install an elongated barrel. Installation of an optical sight is also possible.

Hail, Fellow Scions!

The standard Thermal Cannon that comes from the factory is nice, but I wanted a little bit more.

This matches my alternate carapace gun from my other designs.

I magnetize my Knights at the elbow. There's is a socket there for whatever method you prefer. There are two parts...

1-The Main Gun. I print in a vertical orientation. It takes time, but the barrels don't have droop or supports on them.
2.The Optional Gunshield. This is notched to allow the cannon's sensors to view past it, but still provides a bit of cover.

The gunshield slips over the two barrels of the cannon, and should be glued. Some fitting may be required, depending on your printer.

Make sure you send in pics of your Makes!

Instead of tips, please check out my science fiction series on Amazon. Read the preview chapters, and if you like it, download the ebook.

Armored mech warfare in the arenas and streets of a place called Junctionworld!
https://www.amazon.com/Defiance-Junctionworld-Book-Bear-Ross-ebook/dp/B07XKW213J

Thanks,
JBR

Big props to the originators of the files i remixed from!

These are conversion parts for turning regular Intercessors into Suppressors.

I like the idea of what Suppressors can do but not how the official models look, super unwieldy guns, grav/jump packs not looking jump-packy enough, odd moon boots.
(and those models are only available in a boxed set that also containing lots of stuff im not interested in) .

After looking at some conversions and kitbashes i decided to try doing a remix that would be more to my taste, this is what i came up with.

To use this one needs to cut away the Bolt Rifle from the right hand and scoop material out of the left hand to fit the handle (or replace said hand with an empty bolter left from a previous marine kit).

Ive used Dark Imperium Intercessors for mine but these parts should be usable on pretty much any of the Intercessor models holding their bolter with both hands.

Suppressors go on 40mm bases, here is one: https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:3312581

Description :

2
3

So sexy, So sleek, So very deadly. This here is my remix of BloodyLeechs' Grimdark Chrono Trigger Bits. After I had printed it and assembled it, I just, really didnt like it. It just didnt look right. So I gave it a little attention. I removed the tank on the back and in its place put a Reactor with logo. I got the reactor part from AntomanElven and his Back reactor extension bit. I then put a port hole for the new shoulder stubber and mount, which I aquired from https://www.patreon.com/themakerscult. Then I added a logo to the skirt plate which I also got from AntomanElven. I then replaced the head with one from SebTheis' Dominion Crusader head pack. I included 2 head poses. After that I replaced the arms with well, cooler arms which I got from https://www.patreon.com/ghamak. Lastly I replaced the legs. Oh God I hated those legs. So I took the legs from one of my favorite robots of all time, ED209 and welded them on. Now, she's a thing of beauty.

As soon as I have some more time I am going to work on a fist variant. In the mean time I hope you enjoy.

In the grimdark future, there is no peace between the stars and thus the gargantuan warmachine of the empire can never be allowed to cease its bloody grind for even a moment. To ensure the continued readiness of the millions of tanks, aircraft and artillery pieces of Mankind, these augmented priests wade through hails of gunfire and plasma to apply sacred unguents and binaric rites wherever a machine in the arsenal of Mankind has been crippled. It is their duty to spark their engines back to life and rouse their spirits to join the fray once more, ready to bring death to the enemy and glory to the god of machines.

Countless men and women fight and die across the galaxy each passing day to stem the neverending tide of traitors, mutants and aliens that threaten the forges of their Cult. Occasionally a loyal son of Mars, that fell in battle against the enemies of Man, can be granted a second chance to serve the Quest for Knowledge. Through arcane and ancient procedures he will be reforged into more machine than man, the posthuman peak of the cybernetic arts and perhaps one of the most terrifying shock troopers in the arsenal of mankind. Shrouded in an aura of static white noise, that overloads mechanical receptors and sensory organs alike, they quickly and mercilessly descend upon their disoriented and defenseless prey and disappear again, before their enemies can fully comprehend the slaughter that just transpired.

I have not printed this one yet, so I can't guarantee that the limbs will fit the body perfectly. If you want to give it a go, I would be happy to hear how it turned out.

Even within the dogmatic and zealous organisation, that is the Cult of Machines, few can hope to match the fanatism of these monks, who are going so far as to invite the frightening might of the kinetic force into their very own bodies until their skin cracks and their eyes boil in their sockets under the electrical inferno. But the rewards for the faithful far outweigh such petty losses as sight and sense of touch, as they are able to stride into the apocalyptic battlefields of the future almost naked, untouchable by deadly projectiles and shrapnels, for the kinetic force shields their own from the attacks of the unenlightened in a shroud of lightning. And in turn each strike of the arcane weapons of these pilgrims leaves enemies and heretical warmachines alike lying cold and dead, as their bioelectricity is absorbed from their unworthy bodies.

I always felt a certain affection to this model series, since they were some of my very first models. Now, with six good ones, which carry enough bits to remix a squad of twenty if necessary, I feel like a can put them aside for the time being Hope you are as content with them as I am.

These STL files are designed to equip my [Sculptris Dummies](https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:1972042). You won't be able to import these files into Sculptris, though once you get your character posed, you can align these parts in any model staging platform (MakerBot Deskto, Blender, Meshmixer, or 3D Builder are all good choices). All of these parts are also available in Andrew Stockton's awesome [Desktop Hero](https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/263291121/desktophero-free-3d-printable-character-maker) project as well (which is quite a bit easier than adjusting all the parts by hand). All of these weapons have been scaled to 28mm/Heroic scale, so they should be ready for any kind of miniature conversion if you want to print them separately.

If you make anything with these (including through Desktop Hero), let me know and post a link here in the comments section (and certainly post a remix when you have something printable). I'd love to see what you come up with!

You can find an expanding collection of compatible parts [here](https://www.thingiverse.com/dutchmogul/collections/desktop-hero-parts).

We've set up a [Patreon page](https://www.patreon.com/illgottengames) for anyone who's interested in helping to fund us so we can keep making free and open sourced games like Pocket-Tactics, Wayfarer Tactics. and others, not to mention the growing catalog of gaming miniatures that you can use for whatever you want! (Psst... we take requests and commissions...)

Enjoy!
